create_base_tracker_predictor: create a BaseTrackerPredictor instance for iterative 2D point tracking across video frames
run_base_tracker_predictor_forward: run the forward pass of BaseTrackerPredictor to predict 2D track coordinates and visibility scores
configure_corr_block_sampling: configure CorrBlock with correlation levels and radius for efficient feature matching in track prediction
update_track_features_iteratively: update track features iteratively using EfficientUpdateFormer with residual updates and normalization
predict_visibility_and_confidence: predict visibility and optional confidence scores for tracked points across frames
